zones.name: Aedroch Highlands
zones.lore: A land on the edge of civilization, this frontier teems with beast-men, were-creatures, and wild Gwendannen hill-men who seek the blood of civilized folk. Here the constant struggle betwixt civilization and the Wild rages.

zones.name: Aeran Belendor
zones.lore: Once a mighty stronghold of the Elves, the Archmagi wrought mighty spells here. But now the fey woods run with blood; the Rise of Chaos sundered the wards, and an ancient Terror was loosed from its prison!

zones.name: Aerath Hellendroth
zones.lore: The great cities of the Deathless Empire once stood in these lands, blue and grey towers as tall as the night skies. Now those cities stand in ruin, and the offspring of dark Elvish experiments lurk here, seeking vengeance.

zones.name: Ashfell Plain
zones.lore: This was a peaceful and prosperous land until the shadow of the Dragon fell upon it. Now her townships lie in scorched ruin, abandoned to the scourge of drakes, wyverns, and wyrms that overran the land and killed its people.

zones.name: Aurrochs Skrae
zones.lore: These frigid wastes were held by the Elves of the Deathless Empire until their bestial subjects, the Minotaurs, rose and broke the chains of slavery. Now the Minotaurs guard the remnants of this realm, meeting intruders with brutality.

zones.name: Bone Marches
zones.lore: This blighted plain is the staging ground for the heideous legions of Ithriana, Lich-Queen of Oblivion. Here the minions of the Void raise undead armies, enact foul sacrifices, and guard the Death Gate, black portal to the Void itself.

zones.name: Braedoch Highlands
zones.lore: A land on the edge of civilization, this frontier teems with beast-men, were-creatures, and wild Gwendannen hill-men who seek the blood of civilized folk. Here the constant struggle betwixt civilization and the Wild rages.

zones.name: Derros Plains
zones.lore: Long ago, these lands were won and tamed by the Centaurs, who fought bravely and nobly against the forces of evil. Now they find their rightful lands beset by all manner of foes, yet the Horselords refuse to abandon their pastoral reaches.

zones.name: Doomhorn Skrae
zones.lore: These frigid wastes were held by the Elves of the Deathless Empire until their bestial subjects, the Minotaurs, rose and broke the chains of slavery. Now the Minotaurs guard the remnants of this realm, meeting intruders with brutality.

zones.name: Ecklund Wilds
zones.lore: A rough land, bleak and frigid, this region has been settled by the monstrous bear-men, offspring of the Beast Lords. The Bearkin and have built many strongholds here, defending these lands against all intruders.

zones.name: Fellgrim Forest
zones.lore: Long ago this land was peaceful, tended by Druids and Rangers who venerated the wood. They fought a bloody war against armies of bestial Orcs, and lost. Now the Orcs despoil the forest, razing the mighty trees.

zones.name: Greensward Pyre
zones.lore: The dark powers of a necromancer turned this once-pleasant grassland into a darkling wood of dead trees and blighted, blasted moors. Evil legions of the cursed, the doomed, and the dead stalk the living? and they are hungry.

zones.name: Grimscairne
zones.lore: For thousands of years the Gwendannen dwelt in these hills, burying their chieftains in mighty cairns. The hill-men were driven away long ago, and in their absence an evil has taken root in these lands. The dead kings stir!

zones.name: Hethland Holm
zones.lore: Mighty and fierce, the Invorri thrive in this cold, bleak land, secure in their great halls. The Northmen share their lands with many fierce beasts, and life here is a constant battle against monsters and the elements.

zones.name: Holloch Forest
zones.lore: Once the Wizards of the Conclave held sway here, studying the arcane arts. Something has gone awry, and now old experiments run amok, driving the Magi from the woods and leaving them dark and evil.

zones.name: Hregend Wildlands
zones.lore: A rough land, bleak and frigid, this region has been settled by the monstrous bear-men, offspring of the Beast Lords. The Bearkin and have built many strongholds here, defending these lands against all intruders.

zones.name: Jotensgaard
zones.lore: These rough and inaccessible peaks are home to the Joten, mighty giants who have long warred with Men and Elves. Their strongholds tower on the highest mountains, and giant warriors stride the land, ready to crush their puny foes.

zones.name: Kharsoom
zones.lore: Cataclysms in time out of mind turned these lands into an arid wasteland. A powerful Irekei tribe seized this desert, and has since grown powerful, turning to raids and violence against those who trespass upon their land.

zones.name: Kralgaar Holm
zones.lore: Mighty and fierce, the Invorri thrive in this cold, bleak land, secure in their great halls. The Northmen share their lands with many fierce beasts, and life here is a constant battle against monsters and the elements.

zones.name: Leth'khalivar Desert
zones.lore: These remote deserts are filled with ancient ruins, home to Irekei mystics and other terrors of the desert. Fire giants dwell here, and all attempts to civilize these lands by the Temple of the Flame have failed.

zones.name: Pandemonium
zones.lore: The dark heart of Maelstrom, this blighted place contains the Chaos Gate itself. Since the slipping of the seals, Demons swarm here vast numbers, and rumors whisper they are raising an army to ravage all lands, as they did of old.

zones.name: Phaedra's Prize
zones.lore: The fierce Amazons have been cut off from their homeland since the Turning. One mighty tribe of warrior women, the Palomi sisterhood, has claimed these wetlands for their own, driving out the hideous beasts they found here.

zones.name: Plain of Ashes
zones.lore: The black heart of Oblivion, this blighted realm is dominated by a grim peak, upon which stands the palace of the Lich-Queen. Surrounding it are the keeps of the four Vampire Clans, and evil dwelling places of the Nightborn.

zones.name: Ragnir Holm
zones.lore: Mighty and fierce, the Invorri thrive in this cold, bleak land, secure in their great halls. The Northmen share their lands with many fierce beasts, and life here is a constant battle against monsters and the elements.

zones.name: Sevaath Mere
zones.lore: Once populated by a race older than Men, the ruins of an ancient civilization have been overrun by this foul swamp. Inhabited by the savage Lizard Men, this is a place of danger and darkness, where scaly horrors pray to nightmare gods.

zones.name: Southern Battleground
zones.lore: Once the Order of Sentinels guarded the Chaos Gate with stout fortresses to the north and south. When the Gate seals slipped these lands become battlegrounds, the front lines in a new and terrible war against Chaos.

zones.name: Tainted Swamp
zones.lore: Once this was a mighty forest infested by Orcs, but floods in recent months drove out the Orcs, and brought fouler things. The taint of Chaos has taken deep root here, its foul influence poisoning the water and twisting the wildlife.

zones.name: The Black Bog
zones.lore: In the deepest of the swamps, a terror of legendary size broods and festers - a black drake of devilish cunning and ancient evil. This boggy land teems with its foul offspring, and scaly beings who worship the drakes as gods.

zones.name: The Blood Sands
zones.lore: The mighty B'bhaash Orcs found refuge from their human enemies in these savage desert wastes. Only small corners of this region remain free of Orcish domination, home to the remnants of a displaced Irekei tribe, and other terrors.

zones.name: The Doomplain
zones.lore: Touched by the taint of the Dark, this land is a barren and bleak wasteland, leeched of all life. In this doomed realm even the light of the sun dares not trespass, and hosts of undead seek the souls and flesh of living beings.

zones.name: Thollok Marsh
zones.lore: After their defeat in the War of Ashes, a mighty host of Orcs fled from the lands of Men, taking refuge in these noisome fens. The Orcs grow strong, and these swamps teem with monsters they have raised and nourished.

zones.name: Vale of Nar Addad
zones.lore: This remote desert waste has long been the site of horrific tales of walking serpents. Now it is revealed that this valley once lay at the heart of the Realm of Ardan, and is replete with ancient tombs. What wonders might they still hold?

zones.name: Valkos Wilds
zones.lore: Wild and untamed, this savage forest is home to the madling Aelfborn. In this land, untouched by the axes and plows of civilization, the hybrid beast-kin run free, and the struggle of fang and claw is the only law.

zones.name: Western Battleground
zones.lore: Once the Order of Sentinels guarded the Chaos Gate with stout fortresses to the north and south. When the Gate seals slipped these lands become battlegrounds, the front lines in a new and terrible war against Chaos.

zones.name: Ymur's Crown
zones.lore: These rough and inaccessible peaks are home to the Joten, mighty giants who have long warred with Men and Elves. Their strongholds tower on the highest mountains, and giant warriors stride the land, ready to crush their puny foes.
